# Sigma Earth

> > Sigma Earth connects professionals with sustainability careers and eco-conscious consumers with environmental solutions through integrated job placement and marketplace platforms.

Sigma Earth operates as a comprehensive sustainability platform bridging the gap between green job opportunities and eco-friendly products. The platform serves global markets including India, the Middle East and Africa Region, USA, and Saudi Arabia, with expertise in ESG, environmental health and safety (EHS), and decarbonization initiatives.

- India, Middle East, Africa, USA Markets

## Sustainability Jobs & Careers

- [Sustainability Jobs](https://sigmaearth.com/sustainability-jobs): Job portal for sustainability careers in renewable energy, ESG, and environmental sectors with opportunities in decarbonization roles, EHS positions, and green economy jobs

## Eco-friendly Products & Marketplace

- [Home - Sigma Earth](https://sigmaearth.com/eco-friendly-sustainable-products-services): Marketplace for eco-friendly products and sustainable environmental solutions, featuring green services and sustainable product listings
